rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for cases, bags, and personal belongings carried while travelling.

example.english: I'll pack my baggage before heading out.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zap1 hou2 haang4 lei5 sin1 ceot1 mun4 hau2

rows.note: Use this for psychological or emotional factors that weigh on someone and affect their functioning.

example.english: This has given me a lot of psychological baggage.
example.traditional: 呢件事搞到我有好大心理負擔。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 jau5 hou2 daai6 sam1 lei5 fu6 daam1

rows.note: Use this figuratively for emotional baggage viewed as a burden someone carries around.

example.english: You need to let go of this emotional baggage.
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 fong3 dai1 ni1 go3 baau1 fuk6
